description: Cashier window. Only what the frontend actually calls: one scoped opener:open-url for the release page and the three sites the «Про програму» card links (the-live.shop, technologies.llc, own-net.com). Deliberately no core:default — the JS never imports @tauri-apps/api/{event,window,path,app}, only invoke, and invoke of our own commands is not ACL-gated. See TechDocs/POS_MODULE_TAURI_CAPABILITIES.md before widening this; scripts/check-tauri-capabilities.mjs fails if it drifts.
